label: PROSPECTIVE NEW SEED CONDITION WITH PRE-GENERATION PREDICTION; SYNTHETIC ONLY

protocol.seedRule: Exactly20268028 through20268057, no outcome-based replacement or refill.
protocol.generator: Unchanged scripts/resolution-cohort.mjs generateResolutionMap: row-major uint32 LCG, skip only the two point endpoint draws/cells, retain neighboring walls.
protocol.inclusion: All30 generated maps, including invalid body endpoints, exhausted graphs and budget failures. Reference labels do not filter the cohort.
protocol.policyScope: Existing direct-fine acquisition and existing quality-checked policy fixed before new inputs. Quality policy retains coarse-first acquisition, axis-bound skip, one fine check and valid fallback on optimization timeout. No behavior tuning after outcomes.
protocol.budgetScope: 100 per stage, always-fine maximum100 versus quality-checked maximum200; not an equal-total-budget success comparison.
protocol.metrics: Primary30-map status counts, success and actual full-stage work/calls/model stages; endpoint-valid subset separately. Compare world lengths only on jointly successful maps. Apply shorter-world-length then lower-examined-work criterion per comparable map. Report incomparable failure cases separately, never as cheap efficiency wins.
protocol.predictionQuestion: 새30장에서 두 방식이 같은 길이를 찾은 지도들을 비교하면, 어느 쪽의 총검토량이 더 적을 것 같아? 1: 항상 반 칸, 2: 먼저1칸+추가 확인, 3: 아직 모르겠어.
protocol.comparisonDenominators: The prediction concerns the equal-length jointly successful subset, not pre-filtered inputs. Report its trial IDs/count and matched totals/means; if none, mark comparison unavailable. Also report all failures and any unequal route lengths.
protocol.validationBeforeExecution: Implement/validate a new runner and comparison analysis without target seeds, retain unchanged generator/core/disk/policy hashes, and commit code/protocol/prediction before generating targets. Audit original-world masks, endpoint-valid BFS gate, successful path segments, fallback versus completed optimization, full work and denominator summaries. Exclusive output names, no old raw replacement.
protocol.attribution: Student accepts a guided evaluation criterion, not these exact30seeds/grid/density/budgets or a future result. AI supplies the prospective inputs, implementation/analysis plan and operation.
protocol.scope: Prospective seed condition under the same synthetic generator, with policy rules fixed using previous development data. No targets generated yet, no statistical-independence proof or measured real workload, no universal/continuous-motion/timing-energy/storage/physical-robot claim.
protocol.predictionAttribution: Student selects2, quality-checked lower total work on equal-length joint successes, without reason/count. Preserved before target generation.
